notes.title: Forever Alone Has Just Released!
notes.content:
I've been working on Forever Alone for 2 whole years so it's incredible that it's finally released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40925791/68c0a8f93671e55f97eb299d3f1ab866d1c58b3a.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone who's supported me during the development! I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Playing Through My Demo!
notes.content:
Hello!

I will be streaming the demo for my upcoming game 'Forever Alone' about a young kitten looking for comfort after their mother dies. Be sure to give it a watch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40925791/f16743a282dffe075aa35d18665c05d7448d8eae.png[/img]

See you on stream!

notes.title: Forever Alone is participating in the Steam Next Fest NOW!
notes.content:
The Forever Alone Demo is now part of the Steam Next Fest! I've been working on this game for a while now so it's really incredible that it now has a demo out there for people to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40925791/77f2e1cae1651f8115a930afe8364706df42ca5b.png[/img]

I hope you have fun in this little preview and I look forward to letting you play the full game once it's released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40925791/f16743a282dffe075aa35d18665c05d7448d8eae.png[/img]
